sources.summary: Google 三季度搜索收入增长约 12%，低于分析师预期的 15%，市值一度缩水最多 10%。高管 Philipp Schindler 承认 AI mode 查询的强劲增长因变现率较低产生了影响，同时公司称搜索查询年增速达五年来最高，并计划在美国及国际市场扩大聊天机器人广告项目。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Google 财报后股价一度跌10%，云收入翻倍至307亿美元但搜索收入仅增12%、低于预期的15%，公司承认AI mode查询增长快却变现较低，并计划在国际市场扩展AI mode广告。

en.summary: Google's Q3 search revenue rose about 12%, below analysts' 15% expectation, and its market cap fell by as much as 10% at one point. Executive Philipp Schindler acknowledged that strong growth in AI Mode queries weighed on results due to lower monetization, while the company said search query growth was the highest in five years and it plans to expand its chatbot advertising program in the US and international markets.
en.reason: Google’s search revenue grew about 12%, missing the 15% analysts expected, while its market value briefly fell as much as 10%; Philipp Schindler linked strong AI Mode query growth to lower monetization, and Google planned international chatbot ads.

sources.summary: Addy Osmani 撰文称新版 Claude 模型所需提示词比多数人习惯的更少，针对 Opus 5.5 建议用单一明确目标加验证条件让 Claude 自主工作，从 /effort medium 起步按需调整。

en.summary: Addy Osmani writes that the new Claude models require fewer prompts than most people are used to. For Opus 5.5, he recommends giving a single clear goal plus verification conditions and letting Claude work autonomously, starting at /effort medium and adjusting as needed.
en.reason: Stripping over 80% of the Claude Code system prompt from Claude Opus 5 and Claude Fable 5 caused no measurable coding regression, so Addy Osmani advises giving Opus 5.5 one goal with verification and starting at /effort medium.
